full_text_zh:
[P1] 呼呼呼！
守护犀牛萨米亚的故事
[美] 丹尼尔·柯克 著绘
佟 画 译
北方联合出版传媒（集团）股份有限公司
辽宁少年儿童出版社
本书的部分
收益将捐赠给
莱瓦野生动物
保护区
手机淘宝扫一扫

[P2] 每个人都需要生活在安全的地方。安娜·梅尔兹希望非洲东部的犀牛可以有个躲避风险的家。这里常年有偷猎者捕杀犀牛，因为犀牛角可以卖很多钱。安娜终于在平原的几千英里之外找到了一个很特别的地方，一个避难圣地——莱瓦高地。

[P3] 小家伙看起来很虚弱，情况不太好。
安娜觉得如果自己不帮忙，被遗弃的小
犀牛很可能没办法活下去。于是她
用小毯子裹好小犀牛，决定
把它带回家。
摆在安娜面前的是一项巨大的工程。她需要雇佣工人修建篱笆和道路，还需要警卫保护土地。从
第一天开始，她就密切关注着生活在这里的犀牛。
有一天，安娜发现一只刚出生不久的小犀牛孤
零零地待在那儿。

[P4] 安娜给它取了个名字，叫萨米亚。接下来的几周，安娜悉心照顾萨米亚，喂它吃特殊配方的饲料，希望它能健康长大。

晚上，为了不让萨米亚感到孤单，安娜把它抱到床上。她发现读小动物的故事可以让萨米亚安静下来。

[P5] 萨米亚越长越大。它总是喜欢跟在安娜身后，就像跟着自己的妈妈。
时不时还会发出点儿有趣的声音。
虽然安娜现在还不能完全听懂，可是她已经开始学习了！

[P6] 咳咳？
（你在哪儿？）

嘶喏？
（那是什么呀？）

嘟特！
（我不开心啦！）

呼呼呼！
（我来啦！）

[P7] 安娜很爱萨米亚，并且尽量不把它当作宠物一样对待。让小犀牛学会不依赖人类，回到大自然中，是件很重要的事情。安娜知道是时候帮助萨米亚掌握一些野外生存的本领啦！

[P8] 萨米亚喜欢和安娜的狗狗一起玩耍，可是它更应该习惯和斑马、长颈鹿、牛椋鸟，还有那些大草原上的动物一起生活。

[P9] 为了让萨米亚熟悉原本属于它的生活环境，每天安娜都花很长时间陪它在保护区内散步。萨米亚喜欢跟在安娜身后，用嘴巴叼着她的手指头。

……等萨米亚长大了一点儿，它就跑到前面去，换成安娜牵着它的尾巴，任由它带路。

[P10] 萨米亚温和又有创造力，它有强烈的好奇心，也十分聪明。尽管如此，身边生活着一只活泼的小犀牛可不是件轻松的事儿，特别是当它的体重和一辆小汽车差不多的时候。萨米亚学会了开门，经常突然出现在安娜眼前，吓她一跳。
萨米亚三岁生日那天，它的庆祝方式就是吃掉安娜的草帽！

[P11] 一天晚上，安娜正在洗澡，门突然开了，“呼呼呼！”，
安娜立刻站起来阻止萨米亚
跳进浴缸。

[P12] 还有一次，萨米亚偷偷溜进房间，没想到
进门的时候一下子卡在那儿，动弹不了。安娜
只好给它身上倒了一加仑食用油，萨米亚趁机
使劲儿往后一缩，灰溜溜地跑开了。

[P13] 萨米亚长大以后，大部分时间都和保护区
内的犀牛伙伴们在一起。它经常回来看望安娜，
像从前那样一起散步。萨米亚走在前面，时刻
保护着养育它长大的女人。

[P14] 有时候，他们会走到保护区附近的一个隐蔽的峡谷里，安静地坐在池塘边，听安娜读小动物的故事。安娜知道自己和萨米亚之间有种特殊的友谊……
还有永远不会改变的信任和爱……

[P15] 我在塞伦盖蒂大草原上拍摄和跟踪野生动物时，最难找到的动物之一就是黑犀牛。黑犀牛不仅数量极少，而且极其警觉，它们经常躲在某片灌木丛中，如果有人或车接近，很远就逃之夭夭。黑犀牛在过去的一个世纪中，曾遭到人类疯狂地杀戮，现在整个塞伦盖蒂的黑犀牛不足30头，处于“极度濒危”的状态。我觉得我们每个人都有责任抵制犀牛角及其制品的贸易。我充分了解保护犀牛工作的艰辛和危险，希望大家向这位冒着生命危险为我们保护犀牛的作者致以崇高的敬意。
——野生动物摄影师 非洲的青山

full_text_en:
[P1] Hoo Hoo Hoo!
A Story of Saving Rhinoceros Samia
[USA] Daniel Kirk, Author and Illustrator
Tong, Translator and Illustrator
Northern United Publishing Media (Group) Co., Ltd.
Liaoning Children's Publishing House
Part of the proceeds from this book
will be donated to
Lewa Wildlife
Conservation Area
Scan with Taobao on your phone

[P2] Everyone needs to live in a safe place. Anna Merz hoped that the rhinos of East Africa could have a safe haven. Poachers often killed rhinos here, because rhino horns could be sold for a lot of money. Anna finally found a very special place, a sanctuary—Lewa Highlands, thousands of miles away from the plains.

[P3] The little one looked very weak and was in bad condition.
Anna thought that if she didn't help, the abandoned baby rhino might not survive. So she wrapped the baby rhino in a small blanket and decided to take it home.
Anna faced a huge project. She needed to hire workers to build fences and roads, and also needed guards to protect the land. From the very first day, she closely watched the rhinos living there.
One day, Anna found a baby rhino, born just recently, all alone there.

[P4] Anna gave it a name, Samia. For the next few weeks, Anna carefully took care of Samia, feeding it special formula, hoping it would grow up healthy.

At night, to keep Samia from feeling lonely, Anna brought it to bed. She found that reading stories about small animals helped Samia calm down.

[P5] Samia is growing bigger and bigger. She always likes to follow Anna around, just like following her own mother.
She sometimes makes some funny sounds too.
Although Anna can't understand everything yet, she has already started learning!

[P6] Cough cough?
(Where are you?)

Sshi no?
(What's that?)

Dut!
(I'm not happy!)

Huhuhu!
(I'm coming!)

[P7] Anna loves Samia very much, and tries her best not to treat it like a pet. It's very important to help the baby rhino learn to be independent and return to nature. Anna knows it's time to help Samia learn some survival skills in the wild!

[P8] Samia likes to play with Anna's dogs, but it should get used to living with zebras, giraffes, oxpeckers, and other animals on the savanna.

[P9] To help Samia get familiar with its natural habitat, Anna spends a lot of time every day walking with it in the reserve. Samia likes to follow behind Anna, nibbling on her fingertips.

...When Samia grew a little bigger, it would run ahead, and Anna would hold onto its tail, letting it lead the way.

[P10] Samia is gentle and creative, with a strong curiosity and great intelligence. Nevertheless, living with a lively baby rhino is no easy task, especially when its weight is almost like a small car. Samia learned to open doors and often suddenly appeared in front of Anna, startling her.
On Samia's third birthday, its celebration was eating Anna's straw hat!

[P11] One evening, Anna was taking a bath when the door suddenly opened, "Hoo-hoo-hoo!"
Anna immediately stood up to stop Samia from jumping into the bathtub.

[P12] Once, Samia sneaked into the room, but unexpectedly
got stuck in the doorway and couldn't move. Anna
had to pour a gallon of cooking oil on it, and Samia took the chance
to wriggle backward and slipped away.

[P13] After Samia grew up, most of the time she spent with her rhino companions in the reserve. She often came back to visit Anna, walking together as they used to. Samia walked in front, always protecting the woman who raised her.

[P14] Sometimes, they would walk to a hidden canyon near the reserve, sit quietly by the pond, and listen to Anna read stories about little animals. Anna knew there was a special friendship between herself and Samia...
And there was trust and love that would never change...

[P15] When I was photographing and tracking wildlife on the Serengeti savanna, one of the hardest animals to find was the black rhinoceros. Black rhinos are not only extremely rare, but also highly alert; they often hide in thickets and flee at great distances if people or vehicles approach. Over the past century, black rhinos have been brutally hunted by humans, and now there are fewer than 30 in the entire Serengeti, classified as 'critically endangered'. I believe everyone has a responsibility to resist the trade of rhino horns and their products. I fully understand the hardships and dangers of rhino conservation work, and I hope everyone pays high respect to the author who risks their life to protect rhinos for us.
— Wildlife Photographer, Green Mountains of Africa

full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页是绘本《呼呼呼！守护犀牛萨米亚的故事》的封面，展示了主角犀牛萨米亚在非洲草原上行走的场景，并标注了作者、出版社及部分收益捐赠给莱瓦野生动物保护区的信息。
[P2] 本页介绍了安娜·梅尔兹为保护非洲东部的犀牛，寻找安全避难所的故事背景，并展示了她与两只狗在莱瓦高地观察野生动物的场景。
[P3] 本页描述了安娜在莱瓦高地保护犀牛的过程中，发现一只被遗弃且虚弱的小犀牛，决定将其带回家救助。同时回顾了她为保护犀牛所面临的巨大工程和日常观察工作。
[P4] 安娜为小犀牛取名萨米亚，并悉心照料它，喂食特殊配方饲料，晚上还带它上床，通过读故事帮助它安静入睡。
[P5] 小犀牛萨米亚在安娜家中越长越大，总是跟在安娜身后，发出有趣的声音，安娜正在努力学习理解它。
[P6] 本页通过四个场景展示了小犀牛萨米亚发出的不同声音及其对应的情绪和情境，包括呼唤、好奇、不开心和兴奋，帮助读者理解它的行为语言。
[P7] 安娜与小犀牛萨米亚亲密依偎，她深爱着萨米亚，但意识到必须帮助它学会独立，掌握野外生存技能，以便最终回归自然。
[P8] 本页描绘了小犀牛萨米亚在草原上与斑马、长颈鹿、牛椋鸟等野生动物共同生活的场景，文字强调它应习惯与草原动物相处，而非只与家犬玩耍。
[P9] 安娜每天带小犀牛萨米亚在保护区内散步，帮助它熟悉自然环境。起初萨米亚跟在安娜身后，后来长大一些后，便跑在前面，由安娜牵着尾巴带路。
[P10] 本页描述了小犀牛萨米亚的聪明与活泼，它学会了开门并常吓到安娜，三岁生日时甚至吃掉了安娜的草帽。
[P11] 一天晚上，安娜正在洗澡，小犀牛萨米亚突然推门闯入，安娜立刻站起来阻止它跳进浴缸。
[P12] 小犀牛萨米亚偷偷溜进房间时被门卡住，安娜用食用油帮它脱困，萨米亚趁机溜走。
[P13] 长大后的萨米亚与保护区内的犀牛伙伴们生活在一起，但仍常回来看望安娜，散步时走在前面，保护着养育它的女人。
[P14] 安娜与小犀牛萨米亚在保护区附近的峡谷里，坐在池塘边，安娜为萨米亚和其他动物读故事，画面展现了他们之间深厚而特殊的友谊与信任。
[P15] 本页以野生动物摄影师‘非洲的青山’的口吻，介绍了黑犀牛在塞伦盖蒂大草原的濒危现状，强调其数量稀少、警觉性高，并呼吁抵制犀牛角贸易，致敬保护犀牛的工作者。画面下方配有一只奔跑的小犀牛插图。
[P16] 本页为广告页，宣传Tiger Lee独家资源的高品质电子绘本，包含品牌标识、宣传语、二维码及更新承诺，无绘本故事内容。
